content_sections.heading: IIPA Senior Consultant at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Master's degree in Environmental Science / Environmental Engineering / Water Resources / Civil Engineering, Natural Resources or related discipline, and Ph.D. in any of these subjects
New Delhi, with travel to project districts in Uttar Pradesh and Bihar

content_sections.heading: About IIPA
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Public Administration has its address at I.P. Estate, Ring Road, New Delhi – 110002. The post is for the project "Preparation of District Ganga Plans (DGPs) for Handholding Districts under the GANGA SARTHI Scheme of NMCG". GANGA SARTHI aims to provide institutional and technical handholding support to ten strategically selected districts in Uttar Pradesh and Bihar for preparing scientifically grounded, participatory and actionable District Ganga Plans.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application by email to both addresses: [email protected] and [email protected] . The notice asks for the submission on or before 06 December 2026 and does not print a time. Prepare an updated CV with self-attested copies of the documents listed under Enclosures. Write the position applied for and the project name (GANGA SARTHI – District Ganga Plans) in the email subject. Send the email to both addresses on or before 06 December 2026. Check your email regularly. Shortlisted candidates are told the date and time of the interview by email.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Full-time (Contractual); the position is purely temporary and contractual. Contract duration: 9 months, extendable subject to project requirements and satisfactory performance. Travel, boarding and lodging expenses will be reimbursed as per the Rules. The Senior Consultant reports to the Project Coordinator and works closely with the research team at IIPA. Master's degree in Environmental Science / Environmental Engineering / Water Resources / Civil Engineering, Natural Resources or related discipline from a recognised university. And Ph.D. in any of the above-mentioned subjects. Minimum 6 years of relevant professional experience in research, consultancy or project implementation in river basin planning, water quality assessment, sewage and septage management, solid waste management and river rejuvenation. Prior work with NMCG/ CPCB/ SPCBs/ MoEF&CC/ CWC/ NWQMP/ NRCP/ CPHEEO or State Mission for Clean Ganga. Demonstrated experience in GIS-based spatial analysis, pollution hotspot mapping and stakeholder consultations. Research papers published in journals indexed in Scopus or Web of Science on water resources, pollution control or environmental governance. Understanding of Namami Gange programme, NGRBMP, NMCG guidelines and GIZ–IIPA District Ganga Planning Framework. Strong knowledge of wastewater treatment, solid & plastic waste management, agricultural runoff control and nature-based solutions. Proficiency in ArcGIS and QGIS for GIS-based spatial analysis and remote sensing. Excellent analytical, report-writing and presentation skills. Ability to lead multi-disciplinary teams and mentor junior researchers. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and statistical / analytical software (R, STATA, Python preferred). Preferably below 50 years as of the closing date of the application. Relaxation may be considered in the case of exceptionally qualified and experienced candidates. New Delhi, with travel to project districts in Uttar Pradesh (Hapur, Bulandshahr, Kasganj, Fatehpur, Kaushambi) and Bihar (Buxar, Bhojpur, Patna, Vaishali, Munger) and other locations as required for project-related activities. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the full discipline-specific eligibility.

content_sections.heading: IIPA Senior Consultant Job Description
content_sections.text: Provide leadership, strategic and technical guidance for preparation of District Ganga Plans across ten districts. Oversee baseline assessments, field investigations, pollution hotspot mapping and HVRCA studies. Validate methodology, review draft plans, ensure quality assurance and alignment with NMCG guidelines. Lead thematic action plans on wastewater, solid waste, agricultural runoff, wetland conservation and climate resilience. Facilitate stakeholder consultations, capacity-building workshops and inter-departmental coordination. Liaise with SMCG, District Administrations and District Ganga Committees. Contribute to the final summary report with policy recommendations for scaling DGPs across the Ganga basin.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Updated CV Self-attested copies of educational qualifications Experience certificates Publications/reports (if any) Other supporting documents

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice says that only shortlisted candidates will be informed by email about the interview / test. The interview could be virtual. Meeting the eligibility criteria alone does not give any right to shortlisting or an interview. The notice does not describe the marking or the shortlisting method.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The Institute reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of posts or modify the eligibility criteria at any stage. Candidates must be willing to travel extensively to the project districts in Uttar Pradesh and Bihar as required. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Candidates are advised to check their email regularly.

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Consultant posts has IIPA announced?
faq.answer: IIPA has announced one Senior Consultant post for the GANGA SARTHI project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIPA Senior Consultant post?
faq.answer: The last date is 06 December 2026. The notice asks for applications on or before this date and prints no time.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIPA Senior Consultant post?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in Environmental Science / Environmental Engineering / Water Resources / Civil Engineering, Natural Resources or related discipline from a recognised university is required, along with a Ph.D. in any of these subjects.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The notice says preferably below 50 years as of the closing date of the application. Relaxation may be considered for exceptionally qualified and experienced candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the IIPA Senior Consultant?
faq.answer: The pay is ₹90,000 per month (consolidated). Travel, boarding and lodging expenses will be reimbursed as per the Rules.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the IIPA Senior Consultant post?
faq.answer: Email your updated CV with self-attested copies of qualifications, experience certificates, publications/reports (if any) and other supporting documents to both [email protected] and [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. What should be written in the email subject?
faq.answer: The subject should clearly mention the position applied for and the project name (GANGA SARTHI – District Ganga Plans).

faq.question: Q8. Is the IIPA Senior Consultant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely temporary and contractual, for 9 months, extendable subject to project requirements and satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are informed by email about an interview / test, which could be virtual. Meeting the eligibility criteria does not give any right to shortlisting or an interview.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
